relevance_note: The paper studies three identifiable patients with the disease: "three female patients with familial LCAT deficiency" (M. R., A. R., A. A.), with individual ages, sex and lipoprotein data; no LCAT variant is reported (1970, pre-molecular).
method_note: Read the paper fully by hand; the JSON was assembled with a short Python script from values chosen by reading. The Markdown is OCR of a two-column 1970 PDF, so several Discussion sentences are interleaved with text from the other column; where that happened, spans are given as lists of separate exact fragments (e.g. 'All of the patients have abnormally low' + 'concentrations of HDL in the plasma (1)'). No LCAT variant is described for any patient (biochemical study, no genetic testing), so the variants table is empty; diagnosis is the scope criterion. Ages ('age 21', 'age 35', 'age 42') are given in Methods at the time of study and are recorded as age at last evaluation. Group statements naming all three patients ('All of the patients ...', 'in all the patients') were applied to each patient with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. 'Most of the patients have hyperlipemia (1)' and the hedged 'increased concentrations of LDL' in 'the two older patients seem to be' were not used. Hypertriglyceridemia checklist set observed for A. R. and A. A. from increased plasma VLDL triglyceride concentration; for M. R. the stated absence of increased VLDL triglyceride is narrower than hypertriglyceridemia, so checklist left not reported and a separate excluded feature row recorded. 'The concentration of HDL unesterified cholesterol is normal or nearly normal' (hedged, group) not used. Table II per-patient lipoprotein values (UC, CE/UC, PC, PC/UC, PC/S, TG) not transcribed as features; '-' cells in A. R.'s TG column are undefined and not used. Corneal infiltration, anemia and proteinuria appear only in the general disease description, not for these patients, so not reported. Family relationship of M. R. and A. R. is not stated (only that A. A. is 'from a second Norwegian family'); country not assigned to M. R. and A. R. Publication year is not printed in the Markdown (only 'Received for publication 26 March 1970'), so year left null. No contradictions found.
